notes.notes:
Update Content:
1. The full version of Chapter 1 has released now! Come and uncover the truth behind the theft at the Scarlet Devil Mansion Library!
2. The package structure has been optimized, making the game package smaller and loading faster.
3. The game save location has been adjusted to the game installation directory. (Due to version updates, it is not recommended to use old saves to play the game)
4. Some font colors in the game have been adjusted.
5. Corrected the explanatory text for the crime scene investigation and case reconstruction gameplay.
6. Fixed a BUG that would cause the game to freeze after starting thecrime scene investigation gameplay.
